svg.title: Four processes, one of them trusted with keys
svg.desc: The app is split into a launcher process that only prepares, a secure process that holds the vault and the native core, a call process for telephony, and a dialer process for the optional phone app screens. Below them sit the root daemon, the Titan M2 StrongBox and Android Telecom, with the few connections each process has.
